reviews.comment: Absolutely Loved Essman! Highly recommend this class. He is very caring and understanding of questions and concerns you may have for the class. Quizzes over textbook but if u look over slides before class you should be fine. 3 exams total. HIGHLY Recommend him, lectures were enjoyable too and not boring. If you do the study guide u should be fine!

Dr. Essman is a great professor who cares about his job and the students he teaches. The class consists of three exams, and pop quizzes make up all of your points. If you study with the material he provides, you will succeed on the exams, and you should read the textbook before class to do well on the pop quizzes. I encourage you to take Essman.

LOVED prof Essman! Very caring and chill professor. His class was very well structured and he always lets us out early. You definitely need to study for the exams, but he gives you a study guide with what will be on them. Pop quizzes are given at the beg of some classes, but they are easy and help boost your grade. TAKE HIM! Super nice and genuine
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr.Essman is a great professor! He really does care for his students and makes sure they understand the material. Although, he is a very tough grader on all writing assignments. You have to go above and beyond and more on all assignments in order to just get a high grade. It is necessary to study and memorize material for the exams.
